{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This old '''[[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]]''' was one of several Star Battlecruisers used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The vessel was left as a derelict by the Empire and was scavenged for parts by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They stole reactor systems from the lifeless hulk and used them to power the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The ship's reactors became integral to the security of the base, during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
